description: A component closed with the generic closer </> inside two lowercase elements inside an engine state-child. The state-child parser once let the component's </> pop the innermost lowercase element, consumed the state-child's own </> one level early, and read <Card> as a sibling state-child (false E-ENGINE-STATE-CHILD-MISSING + E-ENGINE-STATE-CHILD-INVALID-VARIANT). Drive On -> Off -> On: the state-child re-renders its component on re-entry and the sibling button after the wrappers stays in the state-child.
rationale: §51.0.B a state-child body is markup rendered when the engine is in that variant; a nested <tag> (here a component call closed with </>, which closes the most-recently-opened element) is markup-as-value. The engine has both state-children, so no state-child diagnostic fires, and re-entering .On renders its body again.
